subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR remain blocked until real embedded-agent proof demonstrates both stale internal handoff removal and `sessions_send` preservation, or should maintainers choose the proof-sufficient broader repair at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 instead?
rationale: The branch changes session-state prompt semantics for six internal handoff tools, and the author explicitly lacks live runtime proof while another open PR overlaps the same issue with stronger proof but different semantics.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording show the stale-internal drop and `sessions_send` preservation cases on the patched branch.

options.title: Select the broader repair
options.body: If maintainers prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical fix, mark this PR superseded only after that direction is explicit or the broader PR lands.

options.title: Narrow the predicate first
options.body: If the six internal source tools are too broad, ask for a smaller predicate and new focused proof before either repair strategy lands.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording show the stale-internal drop and `sessions_send` preservation cases on the patched branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced by PR 65478.
